26. Given two water jugs with capacities X and Y litres. Initially, both the jugs are empty. Also, given that there is an infinite amount of water available. The jugs do not have markings to measure smaller quantities. One can perform the following operations on the jug:
i. Fill any of the jugs completely with water.
ii. Pour water from one jug to the other until one of the jugs is either empty or full, (X, Y) -> (X - d, Y + d)
iii Empty any of the jugs
The task is to determine whether it is possible to measure Z litres of water using both jugs. And if true, print any of the possible ways. [15]
